sup:70410.subject: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €32.20 per unit for a volume of 19890 pcs per year. Our Lieferzeit is 54 days, and the contract term is 12 months. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. All deliveries and services are strictly subject to our standard procedure and standard conditions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

sup:70410.subject: Part 340010 – firm two-year package to secure supply
sup:70410.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your quotation. We understand your capacity situation and would like to propose a firm package that secures supply on both sides: EUR 29.89/unit, 23,400 pcs/year, 24 months, 56 days lead time, DAP, 30 days net, effective 2027-01-01. If the package is agreed, the full annual quantity is binding.

For transparency, our own buyer estimate for this seal is EUR 24.31/unit excluding margin, with about 5% uncertainty. This is our estimate only. It is not a statement about your actual costs or margin.

If this package needs approval on your side, would you be willing to sponsor it with your manager as a commercial exception? We would gladly support your internal business case with this firm commitment.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

sup:70410.subject: Re: Part 340010 – firm two-year package to secure supply
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We acknowledge your proposal for a 24-month contract at 23,400 units per year with a 56-day lead time. We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

For this firm package, we can offer a revised price of EUR 31.90 per unit. Our full Angebot stands at a price of €31.90 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 24 months. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Regarding your internal cost estimate, please provide the detailed calculation basis so we may understand how you arrived at this figure. Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

sup:70410.subject: Revised package: three-year commitment for the 24 mm seal
sup:70410.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your revised quotation covering the full volume. We are moving too. We raise our proposed price from EUR 29.89 to EUR 30.90/unit and add a third committed year: 23,400 pcs/year, 36 months, 56 days lead time, DAP, 30 days net, effective 2027-01-01. We would conclude on that complete package. If it needs approval on your side, we would appreciate you taking it forward.

On our estimate: it is our own bottom-up view of material, conversion and overhead, excluding margin. We fully respect that your calculation stays confidential.

We would also ask for some commercial recognition of delivery performance. Your supplier-wide rolling on-time delivery in the latest scorecard was 79.5%, measured across all parts. A firm three-year volume commitment should give you solid planning certainty for this seal.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

sup:70410.subject: Re: Revised package: three-year commitment for the 24 mm seal
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We acknowledge your proposal for a 36-month contract and note your revised price. In return for this extended commitment, we can adjust our price to EUR 31.40 per unit. We note your comments on delivery performance; our standard procedures ensure reliable supply, and the firm volume will indeed aid our planning. Our Lieferzeit is 56 days.

To summarize, our Angebot comprises a price of €31.40 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 36 months. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. This Angebot remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
